design_decisions.consequence: 5291 holdout rows over 206 chunks, py_src-heavy ({'c_src': 130, 'pe_bin': 1014, 'py_src': 3471, 'rfc_txt': 468, 'rst_doc': 208}); selection ranks by the holdout mixture, disclosed in scope.holdout
design_decisions.decision: the holdout is a chunk-id rule (mod 5 == 0) on the fit block, not a draw
design_decisions.why: 0014's convention; a rule cannot be re-drawn

design_decisions.decision: one selection stage on the whole fit pool, keep 1
design_decisions.why: 0014's two stages existed because its pool was 639227 rows and stage 1 fitted 100000; here the fit pool is 21055 rows, so a second stage would refit the same rows

design_decisions.decision: the logistic head is in the frozen bar set
design_decisions.why: 0014's convention and OPERATING_RULES 4a; 0021 had excluded it from its floor and banked L3 as a sister recipe. The strictest reading in the record, stated in scope.the_bar_and_why_the_logistic_is_in_it

design_decisions.decision: each baseline head is floored at 0021's banked reading of its reference recipe (deep_tree at 0.0)
design_decisions.why: a searched baseline can raise the bar and never lower it below where 0021 measured it (0014's floors, moved to real content)

design_decisions.consequence_found_by_the_gate: the first control selected M4 for the model head and read 0.20: the reader voided it on the aliased reproduction (drift 0.0807). A deterministic refit of M4 on the same rows reads what 0021 read, so a model head that selects M4 is pinned to 0.1193 and cannot clear - the search can only clear through a recipe other than M4. The control now selects M3; a case keeps the aliased path as a clean REAL_RECIPE_FAILS
design_decisions.decision: four reproduction arms (M1, M4, L3, D1 on the whole fit block) within 0.005 of 0021's banked readings, aliased to a head's own confirmatory fit when that head selected the reference recipe
design_decisions.why: ties the run to 0021's machinery and to its numbers; no recipe is fitted twice on the same rows

design_decisions.decision: the null control permutes the whole fit block's labels with the split's own generator at the same state 0021 used
design_decisions.why: the permuted array is 0021's and its hash is sealed as an expectation, one more tie to 0021

design_decisions.decision: scoring on the concatenated [260000 eval + 61409 ext] set, 0021's layout
design_decisions.why: reuses 0021's readings shape and reader logic; the reverse reading on builder content comes for free

design_decisions.decision: per_family over the families present in the scoring set (5 real on the holdout; 8 builder + 8 'ext:' on the confirmatory set)
design_decisions.why: run_recipe_search.score() names the builder's eight families, which the holdout does not contain; the runner replaces the scorer at import and the reader recomputes per_family over sorted(set(fam_s))

pre_freeze_review.method: four independent adversarial readings, one lens each, run in parallel before the freeze: instrument (reader against runner), condition (clause and design), runner (operations and resume), claims (every number and clause text against the banked artifacts). Nothing sealed was found wrong by any lens; the reader's arithmetic was replayed on the runner's own smoke output with zero discrepancies; the null-label hash and every fit-block hash were recomputed from the data with the runner's own code by three of the four lenses.

run_record.cost: selection 1655.5 s wall on one launch (1634.3 s of fits, 1018.7 s of them the model head's eight candidates and 476.0 s the logistic's); confirmation 996.8 s wall on one launch; 2435.9 s of confirmatory fits banked (the M4 reproduction 374.6 s, the searched model 237.8 s). 2652.3 s of wall time in all against the estimate stated in advance of about one hour at three threads. No arm reached its iteration cap; no interruption; load wait 0 s.

what_it_found.macro_average_flag: Had the selection rule averaged the five per-family holdout readings instead of pooling the rows it would have selected M4 for the model and L6 for the logistic (a flag, not a verdict); M4 is pinned to 0021's reading by the reproduction clause and could not have cleared either.
what_it_found.not_a_transfer_reading: An in-distribution reading on real content: the fit and scored chunks are cut from the same five pinned files and share no byte, no chunk id and no source-chunk hash. Nothing here revises 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018, 0019 or 0021, and nothing here establishes a buyer.
what_it_found.one_line: On real content a searched boosted model and a searched linear rule are the same rule: a searched margin of 0.0007 where 0.05 was required, and the search moved neither.
what_it_found.per_family: 0 of 5 real families clear the best frozen head on their own rows by 0.05. The searched logistic leads the searched model outright on py_src (0.1366 against 0.127) and rst_doc (0.1168 against 0.1145); the model leads on c_src (0.129 against 0.1255), pe_bin (0.1013 against 0.0921) and rfc_txt (0.1221 against 0.1188). py_src is the largest family in the fit block (17197 of 26346 fit rows, 7709 scored rows).
what_it_found.the_contrast_with_the_builder_corpus: On the builder's corpus the identical search (0014) moved the model by 0.0489 and the logistic head by 0.0965; on real content it moved them by -0.0004 and 0.0003. The sealed expectation gave the wrong reason for the right outcome: it expected the searched baseline to gain more than the model, as it did on the builder corpus; instead neither gained.
what_it_found.the_search_moved_nothing: Gains from the search over 0021's unsearched readings, by head: model -0.0004, logistic 0.0003, depth-3 tree 0.0044. The searched model M3 reads 14 rows BELOW 0021's unsearched M4 on the same rows (4573 against 4587) while winning the holdout by 0.0012 over M7 (holdout 0.1223 against 0.1211; M4 read 0.12 there). The bar the search had to move rose from 6457 rows to 6468.
what_it_found.what_it_means_for_the_record: 0021's reading stands and gains a searched sibling: on real content, the best boosted recipe on 0014's roster does not beat the best searched linear rule or depth-3 tree by the record's margin. The manufactured-label curve (0003, 0014) is not revised; the real-content thread (0018-0022) closes the recipe excuse. The budget excuse - a scaling curve on real plaintexts - stays open, as what_this_does_not_cover says.

why_this_exists: 0021 read REAL_FIT_FAILS with 0014's model M4 at 0.1193 on the real-family rows, the depth-3 tree at 0.0929 and the standardised logistic L3 at 0.1179, all fitted UNSEARCHED on real content, and its scope deferred 'what a recipe searched on real content would do (the search is a different preregistration)'. This is that preregistration: 0014's roster and selection rule run inside 0021's real fit block, symmetric, with the bar floored at 0021's readings.
